card.title: Pass Me the Authority
card.instruction: Get someone to transfer authority publicly by naming you as the person who decides what happens next.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Hand me the hall key and tell everyone I'm now in charge.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Can't I just give you the key? My retirement taxi's waiting.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: The door will understand. The committee needs words.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: They're outside asking me whether to cancel Saturday's dance.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Tell them I decide whether it goes ahead. Then ask me, in front of them. Your taxi can be my first approval.

mechanism: A requires the retiring holder to publicly name A as decision-maker and demonstrate it through the next live committee question.
confusable: Unlike merely obtaining keys or a title, A must secure a witnessed transfer of who decides next.
comparison: D60-a uses a dance-cancellation question and departure approval; D60-b insists that a private chairing acknowledgment reach the room.
provenance: Direct local assistant candidate preparation; not fresh review or acceptance.
